picks.editorial_note: If verified, an AI system producing a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis — one of mathematics' deepest unsolved problems — would be a landmark moment for AI-assisted discovery, not just incremental research tooling.
picks.title: AI Takes on the Riemann Hypothesis: What Does It Mean for the Future of Mathematics?

picks.editorial_note: At nearly 700,000 participants across 30 UK sites with £10M in NIHR funding, this is the largest AI breast-cancer-screening trial ever run, positioning Cambridge-led research to directly reshape national screening practice.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.editorial_note: A $25M Lilly Endowment gift is one of the largest single AI-in-education investments this week, funding Indiana University's HALE initiative to embed AI literacy across its curriculum.
picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: Aalto's coordination of FCAI-X as a national Flagship Programme center signals Finland's government-backed strategic bet on AI research infrastructure, with Aalto also tied into four other flagship efforts.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A three-way tie-up between a university, a city transportation department, and a national laboratory to pilot AI traffic control shows how academic AI research is translating directly into public infrastructure.
picks.title: Vanderbilt, NDOT, Oak Ridge National Laboratory team up to ease traffic with AI

picks.editorial_note: A Nature Sustainability study quantifying AI data centers' outsized electricity draw adds hard evidence to the policy debate over AI's energy footprint and grid strain, likely to inform coming regulation.
picks.title: These U.S. data centers use four times the power used in LA

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $1M-plus award (including cloud credits) to launch Warsaw's Efficient AI-for-Science framework reflects growing industry investment in building AI research capacity outside the usual US/UK hubs.
picks.title: University of Warsaw

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's CLARKE disaster-response tool earning national recognition and expanding into real emergency-responder workflows demonstrates AI research moving from prototype to operational use with tangible public-safety impact.
picks.title: Texas A&M disaster-response AI gains national recognition, expanded use among emergency responders – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: A four-university collaboration building statistical tools to validate AI-synthesized medical imaging addresses a critical trust gap that could determine whether synthetic data is usable in real clinical and regulatory settings.
picks.title: Can AI expedite medical imaging? Yes — if we can trust the picture
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: MIT-IBM's work diagnosing and benchmarking failure modes in multimodal foundation models tackles a core reliability problem underlying nearly every downstream AI application.
picks.title: Q&A: Enabling more human-like interactions and understanding in multimodal foundation models
